title: Private endpoint & public exposure audit
description: Identifies PaaS resources still accessible over public internet that should use Private Endpoints, and inventories all publicly accessible resources for attack surface awareness.
example_prompt: "List all Storage Accounts, SQL Servers, Key Vaults, Cosmos DB, App Services, and other PaaS resources across subscriptions. For each, check: (1) is public network access enabled? (2) are there private endpoints configured? (3) what is the public FQDN/IP? Flag resources with public access enabled but no private endpoint. Show resource, public endpoint, and recommendation."
